items.t: Family of 19-year-old killed in Jacksonville apartment shooting files wrongful death lawsuit
items.x: Eight months after a teenager was shot and killed inside his apartment, his family is taking legal action against the apartment complex.

items.t: Stolen 6-foot rooster statue returns to Colorado farm after 5 years away
items.x: A 6-foot rooster statue stolen from a Colorado animal sanctuary five years ago has been returned by a stranger, along with a letter detailing its journey.

items.t: Salem ties and scare vibes: Halloween passion powers Orange Park homeowner’s spooky and educational attraction
items.x: With Halloween just two days away, one Orange Park homeowner is putting the finishing touches on a spooky — and surprisingly educational — front-yard attraction that’s become a neighborhood tradition.

items.t: Coming Soon: White Castle gets okay to start construction for $1.9M project in St. Johns County

items.t: Who is running for St. Johns County School Board?
items.x: Tammie McClafferty and Jillian Tozer are competing to represent District 4, which includes Nocatee and Ponte Vedra.

items.t: Youth sports coach sentenced for sexually assaulting 12-year-old girl he coached

items.t: Tributes pour in following 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart's death

items.t: An empty RV City means Jacksonville businesses feel economic impact after Georgia-Florida game heads to Atlanta
items.x: For the first time in over 30 years, the Georgia-Florida game will be played somewhere other than Jacksonville. The reason for the move is the ongoing construction at EverBank stadium. Businesses are feeling the pinch with less visitors…

items.t: Record number of female candidates in 2026 midterms

items.x: Summer James says a payment dispute with a real estate company left her struggling to keep her small cleaning business afloat. She turned to Anthony Austin for help.
